verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a payments platform could plausibly offer user-configurable background automations or workflows. However, the evidence documents no general automation or workflow capability. The closest items are issuing authorization rules that auto-accept or reject transactions and an AI-driven acceptance optimizer. Both are narrow, adjacent payment-decisioning features, not user-built automations that run autonomously in the background.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
